AgentTokenMeter

Zero-dependency local token usage, prompt cache hit/write analytics, and multi-provider official API cost tracker for Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex — one repository, one persistent ledger, native host plugins + live web dashboard.

Changelog · MIT License

> **Inspiration & Credit**: The architecture and design philosophy of this project (zero-dependency Node.js ESM, incremental `Stop` hook archiving, late-binding pricing, and a live local dashboard) were directly inspired by [NianJiuZst/antigravity-token-meter](https://github.com/NianJiuZst/antigravity-token-meter) and generalized here to work natively across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex. --- ## Highlights - **Single Repo, Multi-Agent Native**: Coexisting manifests and hooks for **Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, and **Codex** with zero configuration conflicts. - **Host-Scoped by Default, Combined on Demand**: - Inside **Antigravity**, the side pane defaults to showing **Antigravity** alone (automatically revealing a switcher only when logs from additional agents exist). - Inside **Claude Code**, `install statusline` defaults to `--agent claude-code` (pass `--all` for combined totals). - The shared agent skill defaults to querying the current host agent and switches to `--agent all` when asked for combined totals. - Set `TOKEN_METER_AGENTS=` or `serve --agent --only` for strict single-agent isolation across scanning, hooks, API, and CSV export. - **Exact Per-Agent Accounting (No Double-Counting)**: - **Antigravity**: Disjoint `input_tokens` / `cache_read_tokens`, torn-line protection, terminal billed step recovery, Swarm/Subagent titles, parent model inheritance, and one-time read-only archive import from legacy `~/.gemini/token-meter`. - **Claude Code**: Streaming `(message.id, requestId)` last-write-wins deduplication, recursive `subagents/` & `workflows/` isolation (up to depth 8), `usage.iterations[]` compaction & `thinking_tokens` accounting, 5-minute (`1.25x`) vs 1-hour (`2.0x`) `cache_creation` tiers, and `speed: fast` (`2x`) / `inference_geo: us` (`1.1x`) pricing. - **Codex**: Cumulative `total_token_usage` delta & `token_usage_record` accounting (preventing duplicate/delayed-replay inflation), forked/subagent `session_meta` isolation, revert rollout disambiguation, `.jsonl.zst` compressed & `archived_sessions/` scanning, `service_tier` (`priority`/`fast` `2x`, `flex` `0.5x`) tracking, inclusive-to-disjoint `cached_input_tokens` / `cache_write_input_tokens` normalization, `reasoning_output_tokens` subset tracking, and `turn_context` model lookahead. - **Zero Dependencies & 100% Local**: Pure Node.js ESM (`>=22.15.0`, using built-in `node:zlib` zstd for compressed Codex archives). No `npm install`, no telemetry, no external network calls. Only normalized numeric metrics and short session titles are persisted under `~/.agent-token-meter/` (never raw message bodies). - **Persistent Archive Ledger**: Monthly NDJSON ledger (`events/YYYY-MM.jsonl`) with cross-process file locking and Windows-safe atomic rewrites. Historical usage survives even if original transcripts are later cleaned up. - **Multi-Provider Official Pricing + Custom Overrides**: Declarative official rate cards for **Google Gemini**, **Anthropic Claude**, and **OpenAI GPT / Codex** (including `>200K` Gemini/Claude and `>272K` OpenAI long-context tiers; official `1.25x`/`2.5x` cache-write tiers on GPT-6.x/GPT-5.6 with estimated `2x` long-context scaling, and `1.0x` input rate for models without published cache-write pricing) in `core/rate-card.mjs`, strict suffix matching (preventing mispricing of future minor versions/tiers), honest `unpriced` marking for unknown models, and optional `/pricing.override.json` for custom models or channel multipliers. --- ## Installation ### 1. Antigravity Clone directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/AgentTokenMeter.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-token-meter ``` Antigravity automatically discovers `plugin.json`, activates the root `Stop` hook, loads the `agent-token-meter` skill, and launches the live side-pane dashboard (`sidecar://agent-token-meter/dashboard/`). ### 2. Claude Code **Option A — Native Plugin Marketplace:** ```text /plugin marketplace add KennyMcSimpson/AgentTokenMeter /plugin install agent-token-meter@agent-token-meter-marketplace ``` **Option B — Local Clone + Non-Destructive Hook & StatusLine Setup:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/AgentTokenMeter.git ~/AgentTokenMeter cd ~/AgentTokenMeter # Preview changes safely with --dry-run first node bin/token-meter.mjs install claude --dry-run node bin/token-meter.mjs install claude # Optional: add a compact live statusLine HUD (defaults to Claude Code only; pass --all for combined totals) node bin/token-meter.mjs install statusline ``` ### 3. Codex Clone the repository and optionally wire the non-destructive `Stop` hook (strictly compliant with Codex `hooks.json` schema, preserving any existing `description` and third-party hooks): ```bash git clone https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/AgentTokenMeter.git ~/AgentTokenMeter cd ~/AgentTokenMeter # Preview first, then install Stop hook into $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json node bin/token-meter.mjs install codex --dry-run node bin/token-meter.mjs install codex ``` > **Codex 0.171+ Hook Trust Requirement**: Codex treats newly added user hooks as untrusted until you explicitly approve them. Open `/hooks` in Codex TUI (or the Hooks settings panel in Codex Desktop) and trust the AgentTokenMeter `Stop` hook so it runs automatically at the end of each turn. The installer deliberately never auto-writes trust hashes. Even before approving the hook, `summary` and `serve` perform fast incremental scans across both `$CODEX_HOME/sessions/` and `$CODEX_HOME/archived_sessions/` (including `.jsonl.zst` archives). ### 4. Standalone Local Web Dashboard (Single-Agent or Combined) ```bash # Combined dashboard across all detected agents (auto-hides switcher if only 1 agent has data) node bin/token-meter.mjs serve --port 3456 # Strict single-agent dashboard (scans and displays only Claude Code or Codex) node bin/token-meter.mjs serve --port 3456 --agent claude-code --only node bin/token-meter.mjs serve --port 3456 --agent codex --only # Open http://127.0.0.1:3456 ``` --- ## CLI Reference ```bash # 7-day cross-agent summary (auto-syncs new logs first) node bin/token-meter.mjs summary --days 7 # Filter by agent: all | antigravity | claude-code | codex node bin/token-meter.mjs summary --days 7 --agent claude-code node bin/token-meter.mjs summary --days 7 --agent codex node bin/token-meter.mjs summary --days 1 --agent antigravity # All-time JSON report node bin/token-meter.mjs summary --days 0 --json # Launch local web dashboard (loopback only, DNS-rebinding protected) node bin/token-meter.mjs serve --port 3456 # Compact one-line output for Claude Code statusLine node bin/token-meter.mjs statusline --agent claude-code # View built-in Google / Anthropic / OpenAI rate card node bin/token-meter.mjs pricing # Switch display currency (USD / CNY) node bin/token-meter.mjs set-currency CNY --rate 7.25 # Export daily breakdown to CSV node bin/token-meter.mjs export --days 30 --agent all --out usage.csv # Full rescan & compaction (preserves archived records from deleted logs) node bin/token-meter.mjs sync --full # Cleanly remove installed hooks or statusLine (preserves third-party entries) node bin/token-meter.mjs uninstall claude node bin/token-meter.mjs uninstall statusline node bin/token-meter.mjs uninstall codex ``` --- ## Environment Variables & Custom Pricing | Variable | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | `TOKEN_METER_DATA_DIR` | Override ledger directory (default: `~/.agent-token-meter`) | | `TOKEN_METER_AGENTS` | Comma-separated allowlist of enabled agents (e.g. `claude-code` or `antigravity,codex`) enforced end-to-end | | `TOKEN_METER_DEFAULT_AGENT` | Override default initial view in the Antigravity sidecar (`antigravity` by default) | | `TOKEN_METER_BRAIN_ROOTS` | Override Antigravity brain roots (`:` / `;` separated; empty string disables scan) | | `TOKEN_METER_CLAUDE_ROOTS` | Override Claude Code project roots (defaults to `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects` or `~/.claude/projects`) | | `TOKEN_METER_CODEX_ROOTS` | Override Codex session roots (defaults to `$CODEX_HOME/sessions` and `$CODEX_HOME/archived_sessions`) | | `TOKEN_METER_MAX_ZSTD_BYTES` | Override per-archive `.jsonl.zst` decompression safety limit in bytes (default: 2 GiB) | Create `/pricing.override.json` to add custom models or apply channel/proxy multipliers: ```json { "multipliers": { "antigravity": 1.0, "claude-code": 1.0, "codex": 1.0 }, "models": { "my-internal-model": { "provider": "custom", "input": 1.5, "cacheRead": 0.15, "cacheWrite5m": 1.875, "cacheWrite1h": 3.0, "output": 7.5 } } } ``` --- ## Architecture ```text AgentTokenMeter/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity root plugin manifest ├── hooks.json # Antigravity root Stop hook ├── .claude-plugin/ │ ├── plugin.json # Claude Code plugin manifest │ └── marketplace.json # Claude Code marketplace catalog ├── .codex-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # Codex plugin manifest ├── hooks/ │ ├── hooks.json # Claude Code Stop & SubagentStop hooks │ └── record.mjs # Universal cross-host Stop hook entrypoint ├── core/ │ ├── fs-utils.mjs # Cross-process lock + Windows-safe atomic writes + JSONL collector │ ├── jsonl-reader.mjs # Shared offset/inode delta reader (torn-line & shrink safe) │ ├── rate-card.mjs # Declarative official Google / Anthropic / OpenAI rate table │ ├── pricing.mjs # Pricing engine + strict suffix guard + overrides + prefs │ ├── store.mjs # Unified v2 ledger (v1 backward compatible) + cache │ ├── sync.mjs # Multi-adapter sync orchestration │ └── report.mjs # Cross-agent aggregation, ETag & CSV export ├── adapters/ │ ├── index.mjs # Adapter registry, allowlist & path/content auto-detection │ ├── antigravity.mjs # ~/.gemini/*/brain adapter │ ├── claude-code.mjs # ~/.claude/projects adapter (LWW + subagents + 5m/1h CW) │ └── codex.mjs # $CODEX_HOME/sessions adapter (cumulative delta + inclusive fix) ├── server/ │ ├── api.mjs # Transport-agnostic API controller │ └── http.mjs # Zero-dep loopback HTTP server (Host/Origin validated) ├── sidecars/dashboard/ # Thin Antigravity SidecarApp wrapper ├── ui/ # Single shared frontend (HTML / CSS / SVG JS + HostBridge) ├── bin/ │ ├── token-meter.mjs # Unified CLI & Claude Code statusLine │ └── installer.mjs # Non-destructive config merger (--dry-run supported) ├── skills/agent-token-meter/ │ └── SKILL.md # Shared agent skill instructions (host-scoped by default) └── test/ # Unit, adapter, concurrency, security, HTTP/CLI & manifest tests ``` --- ## Testing ```bash npm test # or node --test test/*.test.mjs ``` --- ## Credits & License - Original concept and Antigravity reference implementation: [NianJiuZst/antigravity-token-meter](https://github.com/NianJiuZst/antigravity-token-meter) (MIT License). - Multi-agent architecture, Claude Code & Codex adapters, standalone dashboard, and security hardening: [AgentTokenMeter](https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/AgentTokenMeter) ([MIT License](./LICENSE)).
